name: Disappointments
overview: Scripture teaches that disappointments are met with a call to trust and reverence toward God rather than envy or despair, as seen in Proverbs 23:17. Believers are encouraged to wait patiently on the Lord, who renews their strength and sustains them through trials (Isaiah 40:31). God's sovereign hand works all things for good for those who love Him and are called according to His purpose (Romans 8:28), assuring us that His plans are of peace and hope despite present difficulties (Jeremiah 29:11). A humble and contrite spirit that fears God's word is the posture God honors amidst life's challenges (Isaiah 66:2), while the carnal mind, opposed to God, cannot comprehend His purposes (Romans 8:7).
